name: taco bell walk-in cooler
description: the refrigerated room behind the kitchen, cold enough to raise a shiver on contact. steel shelving runs floor to ceiling holding dairy, eggs, bulk cheese, and the dented buckets of door sauce. the door seal is missing along a foot of rubber, so every time it swings the light of the kitchen washes in. the floor drain reeks faintly of bleach and old produce. a clipboard by the door tracks a delivery nobody signed.

items.name: cooler shelves
items.description: steel shelving in the cooler loaded with boxes of shredded cheese, tortillas still sealed, and a stack of busing buckets. a lone unwashed tray holds a jar of who-knows-what with a paper date sticker the management is pretending not to see.

items.name: floor drain
items.description: a metal drain grate in the corner of the cooler welded to a bleach-grey piped line. something too small for the grate rattles beneath it when you walk past.
